scope: 本机 Linux 固定 release ELF 的持续运行查询、App 持久观测入口及交接/重建兼容验收；无全局配置 Applied、生产资格或性能证明。

reported_batches.scope: sum of reported Rust test batches, including nested test subprocess output; not a unique test count

host_process_tests.scope: actual MD JOIN server/memfd publisher in parent thread plus independent workers; same PID capture/factory/install/continued input/independent rollback/v4 READY/normal detach, intent lane connected, new_commands=0

app_observation.scope: actual App, independent MD and supervised worker; loopback TLS Spot fill plus fees

recovery.configuration: Observe strategy; cloned account WAL; same actual observation WAL; no worker relaunch or live inference

app_fixture_attempts.scope: fixture-only failures, not implementation regressions or accepted runs

lock_regression.initial_gate: failed: three transient inherited-lock reopen errors
lock_regression.first_delayed_replay: failed: four remaining FileBlobStore inherited-lock errors
lock_regression.final_delayed_replay: passed after the tested owner lifetime fixes
lock_regression.fault_injection: exec entry delayed to hold a real fork-inherited CLOEXEC open-file description; not a performance result

offline_scope: Archived byte hashes, signatures, exact account-prefix hashes and recorded identity/freshness/result bindings are independently checked. ELF and full recovery CAS are omitted; their complete semantic closures were checked online by Rust before archival, and are not reconstructed offline.
